collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — HISTORY AND COLLECTIVE MEMORY (HIS-01..50, draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Old stories, ruins and abandoned places, heirlooms, disputed records, festivals that changed, names on carvings, customs nobody can explain, and the things a people remembers together: some of it painful and handled gently, some of it gloriously silly.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. Edit anything and send it back; nothing ships until you approve.

ledger.why: the casting line, carried out as the roles' ages (picks an elder and a child aged 6-13)

collection.description: A child asks an elder why the fires facing the sea are covered every night: tell the older reason, or say it is just what we do.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: Every night, before the village sleeps, the fires facing the sea are covered with earth and palm leaves so no light shows. Every child learns to do it. Tonight (friend) asks (subject) why, and (subject) says it's to keep the wind from blowing sparks. (friend) points out it isn't windy, and the fires on the inland side aren't covered at all.

choices.label: Say It's Just What We Do

o1.name: Outcome A
o1.text: (subject) sits down. "Long, long ago," (subject.he/she) says carefully, "people were afraid of what might come from the sea at night. Canoes from far away, with people who meant harm. If the village showed no light, they might sail past. So the old people hid the fires. Nobody's come like that for many lifetimes. We still cover them." (friend) is quiet. Then (friend.he/she) covers the fire extra carefully. (subject) watches (friend.him/her) do it.

o2.name: Outcome B
o2.text: "It's just what we do," says (subject). (friend) isn't satisfied, but helps cover the fire anyway. Lying in bed later, (friend.he/she) thinks about it. Something that started for a reason, and kept going after the reason was gone. (friend.He/she) decides to ask again when (friend.he/she) is older. (subject), lying awake on the other side of the village, is thinking about the very same thing.
